title: Moving Company Quote Template
subtitle: A professional quote pre-filled for moving jobs — crew labor, truck and fuel, stairs surcharge, packing, valuation and disassembly. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days of acceptance. Deposit reserves your moving date and is refundable up to 7 days before the move.
notes: Thank you for your business. Quote valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit is due at booking; the balance is due upon completion. Binding vs. non-binding estimates per FMCSA rules.
features: Auto-calculating totals in Excel — subtotal, 25% deposit and balance update automatically
Pre-filled moving line items: crew labor, truck and fuel, stairs surcharge, packing, valuation
Valid-until date and deposit line built in — standard practice for moving quotes
DOT / license field plus binding vs. non-binding note for FMCSA compliance

faqs.q: What should I include on a moving company quote?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and DOT number, the client, move-from and move-to addresses, dated line items (crew labor, truck and fuel, surcharges, packing, valuation), a valid-until date, deposit terms and whether the quote is binding or non-binding. Interstate moves are regulated by FMCSA.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit and balance automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your moving authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
